english: This is an older unencrypted backup. Only continue if you created it and trust where it came from. New portable backups use the encrypted .sccbak format.

english: Factory reset is blocked because this device has no accepted restore test. First restore a current encrypted .sccbak backup, review its control totals, and accept them. Then return here. This proves the rollback path works before data is deleted.
